hypothesis: Correcting only the highest-scoring failed continuation against the best retained successful alternative reduces harmful overconstraint of equivalent successful actions, improving complete navigation beyond ordinary pairwise and policy-weighted set supervision.
data: Existing 35 non-paused frozen roots and all originally safe nonterminal actions. Existing fixed-world A_deploy continuation outcomes/returns only. Even whole numeric cases fit, odd whole cases diagnostic; no new counterfactual labels. Recompute legal CV successor features, not actual-next privileged features.
representation: Concatenate safe-root mean frozen GRU feature and candidate-minus-root-mean feature (512). Standardize with fitting rows only. Frozen GRU and value head unchanged.

fit.batch: all fitting roots, equal root weights
fit.preservation: Mean squared residual divided by0.1 squared on every fitting safe action, including roots with no identifiable success/failure contrast.
fit.contrast: Good = successful AND no geometric contact. Bad = not good. Train preference only when BOTH sets nonempty. No forced preference when all continuations fail or all succeed.

set: CLIC-style policy-weighted target over good actions, using frozen original-score softmax at0.05 restricted to good; KL(target||corrected score softmax over all safe actions). Finite-grid objective adaptation, not official full CLIC reproduction.
regret: ReLU(max_bad(score_bad+margin)-max_good(score_good))/0.05. No pairwise ordering among successful alternatives; common preservation term. Structured max-margin is known; this loss alone is NOT a novelty claim.
consumer: Correct original nonterminal candidate score before unchanged risk/mask/tie. All new arms use identical frozen fixed8 MPPI fallback and evaluate all three residual models for matched computation. Nominal and hold8 reuse exact existing cases300--319 outcomes.
controls: Synthetic distinguishing gradients, equal initialization and parameter shapes, finite optimizer updates, exact zero-correction parity, unsafe/terminal correction zero, GRID80/native50s, six complete native case121 episodes plus one exact duplicate. Smoke is correctness, not task evidence.

development.scope: Known development cases, disjoint from fitting numeric cases; not independent confirmation.

go: No success/contact/collision regression against ANY control; at least2 more successes versus EVERY control OR at least5% lower paired-both-success time versus EVERY control; actual executed residual-induced changes; mean decision below250ms. Fresh run only after passing all and credible incremental-capability review. Fresh evidence requires positive case-bootstrap success interval or paired-time upper interval belowzero against every strong control, and no safety regression.
kill: Correctly activated method fails any task/safety/compute condition, ordinary pair/set learning absorbs benefit, or primary prior fully absorbs claimed capability. No sweeps, no additional labels, no rescue after correct activation.
fairness: Same legal observations, native80, nearest5 encoder/all-human safety, native50s/dt0.25, original reward, margin0.2/risk0.8/smoothing0.3, same initialization/architecture/update count/data/regularization. Fixed-world old-policy labels do not equal legal conditional expected values, and do not certify a changed policy. Local3060 only; no4090.
novelty: UNVERIFIED. This reference tests a specific selection-preserving capability against strong established objectives; no paper PASS from fitting or standard structured loss alone. No old Bayesian, absolute MC refit, episodic retrieval or recovery-network revival.
